marque._commentaire: SETTLED on 3 August 2026: the trade name is « EditionMapoukam ». It lives here, in ONE key, and nowhere else — header, footer, page titles, metadata AND emails all read it from here. A test fails if it is hard-coded anywhere else. The value is identical in both languages: a proper noun is not translated.
marque.baseline: African heritage tales, illustrated and retold for today's children.

etats.chargementLong: This is taking a while. Your connection seems slow — we're still trying.
etats.horsLigneCorps: This page will come back as soon as your connection does.

erreurs._commentaire: Keys match the `code` field of API responses, never their `message`. The API speaks French only; this table is what makes English possible.
erreurs.requete_invalide: Some of the information is incorrect.
erreurs.corps_illisible: The request could not be read.
erreurs.non_authentifie: You need to be signed in.
erreurs.code_invalide: This code is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
erreurs.email_non_verifie: Confirm your email address before signing in.
erreurs.interdit: You don't have access to this page.
erreurs.introuvable: This page doesn't exist, or no longer does.
erreurs.trop_de_requetes: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
erreurs.erreur_interne: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
erreurs.session_expiree: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
erreurs.session_revoquee: Your session was closed as a precaution: a sign-in credential was reused. Please sign in again, and change your password if you don't recognise this activity.
erreurs.hors_extrait: This page is beyond the free preview.
erreurs.telechargement_non_inclus: A subscription gives you online reading. To keep this tale, buy it individually.
erreurs.copie_indisponible: Your copy could not be prepared. Please try again shortly.
erreurs.abonnement_deja_actif: You already have an active subscription.
erreurs.aucun_abonnement_actif: You don’t have an active subscription.
erreurs.commande_non_payable: This order can no longer be paid.
erreurs.confirmation_requise: The country of your payment method changes the applicable price list. Please confirm the new amount.
erreurs.panier_vide: Your basket contains no orderable title.
erreurs.hors_zone: This tale is not yet available for purchase in your region.
erreurs.lecture_non_autorisee: You don’t have access to this title.
erreurs.action_impossible: This action is refused by a business rule.
erreurs.publication_refusee: At least one title is not publishable. Check the list of missing fields in the catalogue.
erreurs.periode_invalide: The requested period is invalid, or longer than three years.
erreurs.fichier_trop_volumineux: The file exceeds the maximum accepted size (100 MB).

regions._commentaire: Keys come from the `region_conte` enum in the database. The labels live here, and only here.

acces._commentaire: Driven by `acces.reason`, never inferred from a price or a flag. `purchase` and `granted` take precedence over everything else: neither a price nor « with your subscription » suits someone who already owns the title.
acces.horsZone: This tale is not yet available for purchase in your region.

auth._commentaire: THREE MESSAGES ARE DELIBERATELY UNDIFFERENTIATED — see the French dictionary, which carries the reasoning. Translating them apart would defeat the point.
auth.nomCompletAide: Optional. It only appears in your personal area.
auth.aucuneDonneeEnfant: This account belongs to an adult. We never ask for any information about children.
auth.inscriptionEnvoyee: Registration recorded. If this address was not already in use, a verification code has just been sent to you.
auth.oubliIntro: Enter your email address: we will send you a six-digit code so you can choose a new password.
auth.oubliEnvoye: If an account exists for this address, a code has just been sent. Check your inbox.
auth.nouveauIntro: Enter the code you received by email, then your new password.
auth.nouveauFait: Your password has been changed. You are now signed in.
auth.confirmationIntro: Enter the six-digit code you received by email to activate your account.
auth.codeAide: Six digits, valid for one hour.
auth.emailNonVerifieRenvoye: If your account exists and is not yet confirmed, a new code has just been sent.
auth.attendre: Too many attempts. Try again in {secondes} seconds.

catalogue._commentaire: The card carries THREE access lines, not two — see the French dictionary, which carries the reasoning.
catalogue.videCorps: Try widening your search: filters can be removed one at a time, or all at once.

fiche._commentaire: Actions are driven by `acces.canRead` and `acces.canDownload`, NEVER inferred from `reason` — see the French dictionary, which carries the reasoning.
fiche.telechargementParAchat: A subscription gives you online reading. To keep this tale and download it, buy it individually.
fiche.extraitSeul: You are reading the preview. The full tale runs to {pages} pages.
fiche.indisponible: This tale is not currently available.
fiche.dansVotreBibliotheque: This tale is in your library.

offres.intro: Read the whole catalogue, or own the tales you love most. Both are possible, and they do not do the same thing.
offres.abonnementResume: Online reading of the whole catalogue, on all your screens.
offres.abonnementDonne1: Online reading of every included tale
offres.abonnementDonne2: New releases as soon as they join the subscription
offres.abonnementNeDonnePas: What the subscription does not give you
offres.abonnementPasTelechargement: Downloading the files. A subscription opens the reading, never the file: when it expires, access to subscription tales stops.
offres.abonnementFermeTitre: The subscription is not open yet
offres.abonnementFermeCorps: The catalogue is still growing. In the meantime, every tale can be bought, and it is yours for good.
offres.achatResume: You buy a tale, it is yours.
offres.achatDonne2: Online reading with no time limit
offres.achatDonne3: Kept even if your subscription expires

accueil.titreBanniere: Tales that once travelled by word of mouth
accueil.corpsBanniere: The heritage of African storytelling, illustrated and retold for today's children. In French and English.

pagination._commentaire: The position is a template rather than a concatenation: word order differs between languages, and concatenating freezes the French one.
